pl.web.notFound.title: Page not found

pl.web.home.title: Overview
pl.web.home.scenarios.title: Key screens preview
pl.web.home.scenarios.description: Each card is a synthetic RFQ in one situation. Open its detail, quote comparison or approval packet to see how the screens behave there.
pl.web.home.scenario.open.title: Open RFQ
pl.web.home.scenario.open.description: Published and taking responses: staff see who has responded, never what they answered.
pl.web.home.scenario.closed.title: Closed RFQ ready for selection
pl.web.home.scenario.closed.description: Every comparison cell state, buyer-recorded quotes, and lines waiting for a winner.
pl.web.home.scenario.blockedApproval.des: A winner's certificate lapsed after submission, so approval is blocked. Shows the previous round.
pl.web.home.scenario.readyApproval.title: Award ready for approval
pl.web.home.scenario.readyApproval.descr: The gate passes, one winner is covered by an active deviation, and one quote was recorded by a buyer.
pl.web.home.scenario.draftWithoutSupplie: No supplier is invited yet, so the response list is empty.
pl.web.home.scenario.slow.title: Slow connection
pl.web.home.scenario.slow.description: The data never arrives, so the screens stay in their loading state.
pl.web.home.scenario.unavailable.title: Service unavailable
pl.web.home.scenario.unavailable.descrip: The read fails, so the screens show their error state with a retry.
pl.web.home.scenario.forbidden.title: No permission
pl.web.home.scenario.forbidden.descripti: The server refuses the reader, so the screens show their no-permission state.
pl.web.home.states.title: Screen states preview
pl.web.home.states.description: Open any screen as it looks when its lists are empty, while it loads, when the service fails, or when you have no access.
pl.web.dashboard.rfqs.title: RFQs
pl.web.dashboard.rfqs.noneOpen: No RFQ is open for responses.
pl.web.dashboard.rfqs.empty.title: No RFQs yet
pl.web.dashboard.rfqs.empty.description: Build your first RFQ from the parts list.
pl.web.dashboard.evidence.title: Evidence
pl.web.dashboard.evidence.empty.title: Nothing to review
pl.web.dashboard.evidence.empty.descript: No document awaits confirmation and no approved supplier lacks required evidence.
pl.web.dashboard.suppliers.title: Suppliers needing attention
pl.web.dashboard.suppliers.allClear: No supplier's approval or evidence has expired or ends within 60 days.
pl.web.dashboard.suppliers.empty.title: No suppliers yet
pl.web.dashboard.suppliers.empty.descrip: Suppliers arrive through an import with their approved scope and expiry.
